title: TRUCK DOCK DIVING
prompt: Revise this original TRUCK DOCK DIVING logo to feel MUCH more authentically like a 1997–2002 PlayStation mascot platformer / party game logo. Keep the correct words, airborne semi truck, wooden dock and splashing water. Chunky wobbly uneven individually drawn letters, thick blue-black outline, cream keyline, simple bold 3-tone painted planes and exaggerated cartoon bevels. Low-poly faceted cartoon truck, oversized wheels, simple cel-painted surfaces. Bold sculptural splash shapes, not tiny realistic droplets. Saturated cyan, royal blue, tangerine. Crisp HD, no pixelation, photographic metal or fine noise. Transparent background, clear margins.
